claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivationPhase / direct
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Fabricate has no attack roll and no saving throw — it is an unconditional transformation. The current ActivationPhase union only has 'attack_roll' and 'save_gate'. A 'direct' phase variant (no resolution gating) is needed for spells whose effect fires without any check.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You convert raw materials into products of the same material.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Effect / create_object
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Fabricate's sole effect is producing a physical object from raw materials. The v4 taxonomy lists 'create_object' as an effect atom (§9), but the surface Effect type only contains DamageEffect | NoneEffect. A create_object variant is required.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can fabricate a Large or smaller object (contained within a 10-foot Cube or eight connected 5-foot Cubes) given a sufficient quantity of material

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment / object
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell targets raw materials (objects), not creatures. The v4 taxonomy lists 'object' as an attachment atom (§3), but the surface Attachment union only covers self | target | area | mark. An 'object' attachment variant is needed for spells that operate on inanimate matter.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose raw materials that you can see within range.
